text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"So this is the training camp...
Trainer, there's something I'd like to ask you."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this training camp facility...
has a buffet?
choice_data_list: ...Haven't you forgotten this is a training camp?
...Haven't you forgotten we're at training camp?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No, I haven't forgotten.
Nor have I forgotten how important this training camp is."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To win every single race,
I plan on training thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be fine. I'll do my best.
...I just think meals are important too, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Our intense summer training camp with Oguri Cap has begun!
